text:
Clara Wu: Dropping a compact proposal: introduce a soft vs hard guardrail distinction in the Autoscale row. Soft = inline warning + suggested auto-fix. Hard = block with confirm dialog. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/zxcv/soft-hard-guardrails Diego Rivera: Love the distinction. Copy idea: soft = 'Guardrail suggestion: this setting may increase P95' (action: 'Apply suggested'), hard = 'Guardrail enforced: change blocked' (action: 'Request override'). Sam Ortiz: Add a small cost-preview under the collapsed row: percent for quick scan, click chevron to see dollar/day estimate. Keeps density but surfaces economics. Tooltip: 'Est. cost delta based on recent traffic window'. Priya Sharma: Accessibility: soft warnings must be announced via aria-live polite and include suggested safe value. Hard guardrail dialog should be role=alertdialog and keyboard-trappable. Add offscreen summary id referenced by the row: aria-describedby='autoscale-summary-2175000123'. Miles Carter: UX: show which pool supplies burst tokens with a tiny connector line between the burst badge and pool chip. If burst spans multiple pools show 'Burst: pooled (N sources)'. Also show a small estimated tokens count. Clara Wu: Interaction: when user toggles density/compressed mode hide dollar details but keep percent & aria fallback that reads full dollar text on focus. Density persists per-user. Diego Rivera: Edge case: pinned pool with low spare GPUs -> show 'Burst unavailable pinned pool: no spare GPUs' with lock icon + text. Add action 'Switch to elastic' that opens pool picker. Make sure color is not sole signal. Sam Ortiz: Keyboard flow: collapsed row chevron -> expand -> min -> max -> burst badge -> burst picker -> SLO slider -> soft guardrail suggestion -> apply suggested. Escape closes and returns to chevron. Tooltips/popovers must be focusable and close on Escape. Priya Sharma: SLO slider a11y: use aria-valuetext like 'SLO target 250ms est p95 310ms, cost +6%'. Debounce live updates 300ms when scrubbing to avoid AT spam. Offscreen element: '
Autoscale min 1 max 8. Burst: elastic pool-b (5 tokens). Safe SLO range 200ms-500ms.
'. Miles Carter: Visual: guardrail suggestion banner should persist until action taken. If user force-applies show an undo pill 'Applied 1m ago undo' visible in row. Undo should revert config and show recomputed estimate. a11y-bot: Checklist: test NVDA/VoiceOver keyboard-only, ensure aria-live debounced, confirm alertdialog semantics for hard guardrails, and validate that burst state has both icon + text. Debounce estimate updates 300ms and dedupe identical messages. Clara Wu: I'll update the mock to include soft/hard states, cost-preview compact view, pool connector, and offscreen ids. Tagging @Priya for a11y signoff and @Diego for copy. ETA: EOD tomorrow. :rocket:
